independenceStatement: Expected values derived ONLY from the fixture's known construction (1 page, MediaBox [0 0 612 792], /Rotate 90; no CropBox so PDFKit reports cropBox=mediaBox). Sample normalization is against the MEDIABOX and is unaffected by /Rotate: nx=(x-0)/612, ny=(y-0)/792. The 0.25 point discriminates: a harness that let /Rotate 90 swap width and height would yield (153/792, 198/612) = (0.193181818, 0.323529412), not (0.25, 0.25). Independent of harness output (A07-GATE-00 §3).
